svg.title: Pressure-flow curves for two fixed resistances
svg.desc: Horizontal axis: pressure difference from 0 to 108 mmHg. Vertical axis: flow in liters per minute. The solid teal line uses resistance 18 mmHg minute per liter; the dashed brown line uses 36. Both pass through zero. At the marked pressure difference of 90 mmHg, the flows are 5 and 2.5 liters per minute. These are synthetic algebraic model values, not measurements or a whole-circulation prediction.
